_comment: LinkKeeper config template. Copy to config.json and edit for your setup (the daemon auto-copies this on first run). Links are auto-discovered from any interface that owns a default gateway; the 'links' rules below just give friendly names / carrier labels and tell USB tethers apart by USB vendor id. Leave 'links': [] to auto-manage every default-route interface with generated names.

probe._comment: Each link gets a dedicated IP from 'pool' and is health-checked over ITS OWN interface via a pinned /32 host route (so a backup link is verified correctly on Windows). loss_window=10 so one dropped probe = 10% loss. Orphaned routes are reconciled each cycle.

decision._comment: Best link = trusted first, then wired (while clean), then lowest score = latency + jitter_weight*jitter + loss_weight_ms_per_pct*loss%. Switch away from a healthy primary only on a better class or a score win > switch_margin_ms, after switchback_dwell_seconds (anti-flap).

links.name: Ethernet-LAN
links.note: Example: a wired broadband line. Match your NIC by the adapter description substring (e.g. '2.5GbE' or 'Realtek') so it never clashes with USB tethers.

links.name: PhoneA-USB
links.note: Example: a phone USB tether. 'vid' is the USB vendor id (Samsung=04E8, OnePlus/OPPO=22D9, etc.) so two tethers are told apart. Find it: Get-CimInstance Win32_NetworkAdapter -Filter InterfaceIndex=N | Select PNPDeviceID.

links.name: PhoneA-WiFi
links.note: Example: a phone Wi-Fi hotspot, matched by SSID (substring, tolerates Windows' ' 2' duplicate-name suffix).

advisor._comment: Diagnoses why a link dropped (missing, no-internet, single-link, no carrier diversity, Windows power settings that kill tethers) with per-device fix steps in the dashboard/--advise.

_manage_note: manage_unmatched:true = also monitor any internet-providing interface no rule names (Ethernet, another Wi-Fi, a new tether, Bluetooth). 'exclude' skips virtual/VPN/tunnel adapters by name substring.

open_join._comment: OPT-IN, UNTRUSTED LAST RESORT. When enabled AND no trusted link is healthy AND Windows Location is on, LinkKeeper joins a password-free network that passes a captive-portal + real-internet check, treats it as untrusted, and drops it the instant a trusted link returns.

wifi._comment: One Wi-Fi radio = one hotspot at a time. If not on any SSID in this priority list, LinkKeeper connects to the first available (once per retry_seconds).

netscan._comment: LAN device map + new-device alerts (dashboard Network tab). Ping-sweeps the local /24 + reads the ARP table (no elevation) every scan_interval_seconds; toasts + flags any MAC not in 'known'. Devices present at daemon start are auto-baselined. Trust from the dashboard to add to 'known'. Phones randomize Wi-Fi MACs, so a returning phone can look new until trusted. scan_wifi lists nearby Wi-Fi networks every wifi_scan_interval_seconds (needs Windows Location ON). router_scan TCP-probes router_ports on the gateway every router_scan_interval_seconds — reachability only, not a vulnerability scan; findings surface as Advisor warnings.

ui._comment: wizard_completed:false triggers the first-run setup wizard.

notify._comment: Windows toast on every primary switch.

speedtest.note: OFF by default. Ranks links by measured speed when on (uses data).
